titulo: The burner off on the way out
caption:
The burner off on the way out

The pot was still bubbling when she passed. She turned the burner off and the steam let go.

Turning it off is one motion, and nothing is left running behind you.

For whoever turns the burner off before walking away.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A kitchen with a pot of soup on the right, its lid rattling and steam rising. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the lid drops, the steam stops and the pot goes still. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse.
